cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Inspector, please approve our invisible landing. The museum opens Monday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. We've budgeted enough confidence to hold twenty visitors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How am I supposed to certify confidence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign under 'load-bearing.' Your professional certainty will support the inspectors too, so we won't need scaffolding for the next inspection.

confusable: D148 wants certification; D138 learns real procedure rather than worsening plan logic.
comparison: Weather guarantee versus invisible museum landing.
seedUse: Keep B certification question causing literal load-bearing signature.
